Name: Gentle Snow
Author: kittnet
Description:
[left][/left][center]The snow effect is very pretty, but I find it to be a little painful on my eyes.
The new Snow Transparency slider is nice, but I still want to be able to see the snow...
Therefore, I decided to remake it, to be much more gentle.
I made this for my own use, but I thought that perhaps others might like it, too.
Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19068]Mild Snow[/url]﻿.[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19068]
[/url]﻿
[img]https://i.imgur.com/9ZFo3xf.gif[/img]﻿

The only thing this mod does is change the snow animation. It's very simple.

[u][b]To install:[/b][/u]
1. Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
2. Download the Main File.
3. Unzip and move to Stardew Valley\Mods.[/center]
